verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity documents programmatic API access with a secret key to most verification details, including collected images and extracted ID data, so a user could pull their data out record by record. There is no evidence of a bulk or complete export, documented open export formats, or a migration/offboarding path for leaving. Missing for 10: bulk/full-account export, documented open export formats, migration or offboarding guidance, independent corroboration.
